dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I asked Wolfy some questions about this place. He seemed very happy to answer them.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe... It's a little embarrassing to say, but I thought I could only talk to him because of my ability to communicate with animals.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It seems that there are still many things I need to learn about in this world.
